name: qa-serverless
description: Serverless platform testing: 5 skills (aws-sam-local-testing with .NET Lambda test tools in references, azure-functions-tests, cloudflare-workers-miniflare, cold-start-budget-reference with timeout + billing budgets in references, serverless-integration-test-builder) and 1 agent (serverless-cold-start-critic). Covers Lambda / Workers / Edge runtimes which have specific testing patterns (cold-start budgets, timeout testing, local emulators, edge-runtime divergence) absent from generic web-server test plugins.
